title: Unified Customer 360 Across ERP, Commerce and Support
raw_text: Beaumont Retail Holdings operates 340 stores, a Cegid ERP instance, and a separate commerce platform, with customer records created independently by each channel and by our contact centre. We need a unified customer record built through system integration across ERP, e-commerce, marketing, and support systems. Identity resolution must match records on email, loyalty number, and postcode where no stable identifier exists. On GCP with BigQuery as the analytical landing zone, we require a single customer view consumable by marketing and by store staff. Consent and opt-out state must propagate to every downstream system within one day.
requirements: System integration unifying Cegid ERP, commerce, marketing, and support records
Identity resolution on email, loyalty number, and postcode fallback
BigQuery analytical landing zone on GCP
Consent and opt-out propagation to downstream systems within 24 hours
